four_layer_diagnosis.environment: wrong pressures -- the agent DIES of health_depleted at step 32/27/22 after env.reset() (governance re-probe, seeds 42/123/456, driver env params size=5 num_hazards=1 num_resources=3), and the driver NEVER READS done: env.step() returns (flat_obs, harm_signal, done, info, obs_dict) and both _collect_battery (:330) and the P0 loop (:499) take out[-1], discarding out[2]. With BURN_IN_STEPS=30 every one of the 512 battery rows is POST-DEATH, on a world_state that accrues without bound (|ws| 5.9 at step 31 -> 8.5 at 100 -> 21.2 at 300 -> 39.7 at 600). The driver's docstring:147 states this is inherited unchanged from V3-EXQ-1075.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: misleading -- d_act carries a genuinely ANALYTIC null of 0 (verified in code: _swap_errors averages the ERRORS over the 4 alternative actions, not the predictions, so there is no Jensen term; the recorded random-init head sits at |d| <= 0.022 in all 9 cells), but the DV is strongly NON-STATIONARY along the battery. Governance recompute from per_row_se_* at alpha 0.3: rows 0-63 give d_act -0.0762/+0.0556/-0.0321, rows 64+ give +0.1991/+0.2384/+0.2577, rows 448-511 give +0.4049/+0.2964/+0.2903. The battery is ONE ORDERED TRAJECTORY through a drifting accumulator, not 512 exchangeable transitions.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: coupled -- the manipulation (alpha_world) moves the DV monotonically on 3/3 seeds and the positive control is live on 3/3
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate in row count but NOT in independence -- 512 rows are serially dependent along one post-death trajectory; the paired row bootstrap resamples row indices and so does not price that dependence.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: SD-PP-B5's validated-negative was measured at alpha_world 0.3 (violating SD-008's >= 0.9 floor) AND on a battery collected from a dead agent -- QUALIFY the verdict, do not re-open it
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: Do NOT read SD-PP-B5's validated-negative as a clean negative: both runs it rests on (V3-EXQ-1073, V3-EXQ-1075) ran at alpha_world 0.3, where per-step z_world displacement is 3.0-3.1x smaller, and both collect their battery after the agent has died of health_depleted without ever reading `done`. EQUALLY, do NOT read V3-EXQ-1079 as evidence the manipulation works: the head's absolute predictive quality FALLS with alpha (model_r2 0.88->0.72 on 3/3) and it remains below the identity predictor at every alpha tested. Any re-validation must (a) set alpha_world >= 0.9 explicitly and record it, (b) reset the env on `done` or record the battery's post-death position and world_state norm, and (c) route on a statistic with an ANALYTIC null, not a measured battery-ratio null.

failure_record_entry.metric: alpha_world 0.3 vs 0.9: rms_dz_per_dim 0.0073-0.0086 -> 0.0228-0.0261 (3.0-3.1x); head action-read d_act +0.17/+0.23/+0.24 -> +0.39/+0.50/+0.50 (paired-bootstrap CI above 0 on 3/3). BUT model_r2 FALLS 0.8828/0.9214/0.8792 -> 0.7247/0.6795/0.7030 and skill_vs_identity stays negative at every alpha. Battery non-stationary: d_act rows 0-63 = -0.0762/+0.0556/-0.0321 vs rows 448-511 = +0.4049/+0.2964/+0.2903, on a post-death trajectory (health_depleted at step 32/27/22; |world_state| 5.9->39.7 over 600 steps).
failure_record_entry.target: A re-validation must set alpha_world >= 0.9 explicitly AND reset on `done` (or record post-death position + world_state norm per battery row) AND report model_r2 alongside any persistence-relative skill, so a baseline collapse is never readable as head improvement.

learning_extracted: VERDICT STANDS: the pre-registered GROWS route is ROBUST and survives the red-team. d_act(0.9) > d_act(0.3) in every 64-row block of every seed, and the governance recompute reproduces every recorded value exactly. Raising alpha_world from 0.3 to 0.9 really does increase the world-forward head's action read.

GFLAG-0434 is CONFIRMED AT SOURCE by a purpose-built run. The action-blind null of 0.5632/0.5824/0.5063 that GFLAG-0432 and the V3-EXQ-1075a stop handover rest on is reproduced EXACTLY under 1075's collection order and shown to be a warm-up/order artifact: counterfactual-battery-first gives 2.3397/2.4102/2.2556, and with burn-in it lands at 1.0404/1.2012/0.9337, on top of the random-init null 1.0063/1.0184/1.0019.

GFLAG-0433's premise is now MEASURED, not argued: per-step z_world displacement is 3.0-3.1x larger at alpha_world 0.9 than 0.3 (rms_dz_per_dim 0.0073-0.0086 -> 0.0228-0.0261), and V3-EXQ-1073/1075 both inherited 0.3 from REEConfig.from_dims against SD-008's stable floor of >= 0.9.

GFLAG-0432 MUST NOT BE APPLIED AS DRAFTED, and the reason is stronger than first drafted. Its evidence (the trained OFF head leading a MEASURED blind null by 0.20-0.30) is invalid -- against the corrected burn-in null the head sits BELOW on 3/3. Its CONCLUSION ('the head already reads its action at 0.3') is ALSO regime-dependent: on the 1075-comparable 64-row window d_act at alpha 0.3 is -0.0762/+0.0556/-0.0321, i.e. NEGATIVE on 2 of 3 seeds. The conclusion holds only on the full 512-row drifted battery. So the fix is NOT to re-denominate criterion (i) on a better measured null -- any measured null on this battery inherits the non-stationarity -- it is to route on a statistic with an ANALYTIC null AND to fix the battery.

THE HEAD DOES NOT IMPROVE WITH ALPHA -- the persistence sign-flip is BASELINE-DRIVEN, and this is the single most misreadable number in the run. persistence_relative_skill goes -0.2335/-0.0748/-0.3019 at alpha 0.3 to +0.2429/+0.1303/+0.1992 at 0.9, which reads as the head becoming competent. It is not: model_r2 FALLS on 3/3 seeds (0.8828->0.7247, 0.9214->0.6795, 0.8792->0.7030) while persistence_r2 collapses further (0.9272->0.5480, 0.9324->0.5835, 0.9352->0.5553). Less EMA smoothing makes copy-the-input a much worse predictor; the head is an absolutely WORSE predictor at 0.9 and merely loses by less. Consistent with this, skill_vs_identity_1075_order stays NEGATIVE at every alpha (-5.82/-2.24/-8.39 at 0.3; -2.14/-2.08/-2.68 at 1.0).

SHARED INSTRUMENT DEFECT ACROSS THE LINEAGE, and it is the finding with the widest reach: the agent dies (health_depleted) at step 32/27/22 after env.reset() and the driver never reads `done` (env.step returns (flat_obs, harm_signal, done, info, obs_dict); _collect_battery:330 and the P0 loop:499 both take out[-1]). Every battery row is post-death on an unboundedly accruing world_state. The driver's own docstring:147 records this as INHERITED UNCHANGED FROM V3-EXQ-1075 -- so V3-EXQ-1073 and V3-EXQ-1075, the two runs SD-PP-B5's validated-negative rests on, carry it too. Whether other runs in the corpus share it is NOT established here and is raised to the user as a scoping decision, not assumed.

The 512-row battery choice reached positive-control liveness (1/3 -> 3/3 seeds) by EXTENDING INTO THE DRIFTED REGIME, not by narrowing a confidence interval. Governance recompute: the positive control's own rows 0-63 read -0.0089/+0.1375/+0.0939 at alpha 0.3, i.e. near-zero linearly readable action information early in the battery. The instrument choice is therefore not outcome selection, but its stated justification (liveness as a clean non-degeneracy criterion) is not the whole story and is corrected here.

RECORDING PRECEDENT: alpha_world was never set by V3-EXQ-1073/1075 and was inherited silently from REEConfig.from_dims. A parameter that moves a DV 3x must be explicitly set and recorded, not inherited. The manifest's config block also omits BURNIN_BATTERY_N=512, the single most consequential instrument parameter in this run.

post_confirmation_addenda.text: Section 6 item 2 (and, in the JSON, net_classification, implementation_hint and the SHARED INSTRUMENT DEFECT finding) say V3-EXQ-1073 also collected its battery after the agent died without reading `done`. That is FALSE for 1073: its _sample_probe_battery and P0 loop unpack `done` and reset (ree-v3 experiments/v3_exq_1073_mech572_precision_provenance_gain.py:1054-1057, 1170-1175, 1422-1426). The post-death defect applies to V3-EXQ-1075 and V3-EXQ-1079 only -- this driver's docstring records inheritance from 1075, and the extension to 1073 was not verified. Consequence for SD-PP-B5: of the two runs its validated-negative rests on, only 1075 carries the dead-agent defect; BOTH still ran at alpha_world 0.3 (unchanged, correct). SD-PP-B5's validation_outcome carries the matching correction (REE_assembly 65bb05ec9c). Found by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1082_2026-09-24 sec. 2.
